description:
Located adjacent to the Temora Airport and the renowned Temora Aviation Museum, cmca Temora Airfield Tourist Park offers a unique and welcoming stay for travellers exploring the Riverina region. Access the park via Tigermoth Avenue off Tenefts Street, where the on-site Park Custodian will assist with check-in and site allocation.

This dog-friendly tourist park features:
